name: Sagara Yukie
source:
An older girl who serves as the nurse and teacher of the academy.
Despite looking cheerful and polite on the surface, she is a mischievous person by nature, and a pain to be around sometimes.
She has a long relationship with the MC's family. She visited him often when he got a cold, and she accidentally gave him the medicine that cause his pheromones to be released. She was the first to experience his Beast Power.
She has a strong sexual drive, to the point where the MC is squeezed to the last drop.
